The [[Standard year/Legends|year]] '''440 before the Battle of Yavin (BBY)''' was a period of [[Time/Legends|time]] during the [[Great Peace of the Republic]]. Around that year, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] launched their mobile training vessel, the ''[[Chu'unthor]]''.<ref name="Power" />
